VoiceNote.title: VoiceNote
VoiceNote.description: A transcribed voice journal note with AI-structured action items, contextual topic tone, and Google Search fact-checking citations.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

title.description: Short descriptive title generated from the voice memo.

summary.description: Concise executive summary of the recording adapted to the note's topic and structure preference.

transcript.description: Clean transcription of the audio recording.

detectedTone.description: AI-detected topic tone used for contextual summarization.

actionItems.description: Bulleted action items extracted from the memo.

decisions.description: Key decisions, agreements, or conclusions reached in the memo or meeting.

claimsToVerify.description: Questions or factual claims detected in the memo for live search verification.

claimVerdicts.description: Structured per-claim fact-check verdicts (supported, updated, disputed, unverified) with concise explanations.

factCheckStatus.description: Fact-checking status for the voice note.

searchQueries.description: Google Search queries executed during grounding.

sources.description: Verified web source links returned by Google Search grounding.

flashcards.description: AI-generated Q&A study flashcards derived from the note transcript and verified findings.

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top.

tags.description: Normalized lowercase hashtag labels (max 10, without leading #) for categorization and retrieval.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A follow-up conversation message attached to a specific voice note.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

role.description: Sender role in the note conversation.

searchQueries.description: Google Search queries executed for grounded assistant replies.

sources.description: Web citations attached to grounded assistant replies.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Synced user preferences including Brief vs Detailed note structure mode and Contextual Summarization toggle.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the preference owner.

contextualSummarization.description: Whether Gemini automatically analyzes the note topic ('academic', 'technical', 'professional', 'casual') and adapts summary tone and structure.

FactCheckSearchItem.title: FactCheckSearchItem
FactCheckSearchItem.description: A tracked fact-check topic or search query from previous verified searches, used for auto-complete suggestions and recurring topic re-verification.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the search topic owner.

query.description: The exact fact-check query or claim statement.

topic.description: Normalized category or high-level topic title.

verificationCount.description: Number of times this claim or topic has been verified.

lastStatus.description: Verdict status from the most recent search.

lastExplanation.description: Concise grounded explanation from the most recent verification.

sourceUrl.description: Primary citation URL from previous search grounding.

lastNoteId.description: Optional ID of the most recent voice note associated with this fact-check.

lastNoteTitle.description: Optional title of the most recent voice note associated with this fact-check.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent verification.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User-owned voice journal notes with transcriptions, action items, contextual tone, and search-grounded fact checks.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}/messages/.description: Follow-up Gemini chatbot messages scoped to a voice note.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Synced per-user preferences including Brief vs Detailed note structure mode and Contextual Summarization toggle.

/users/{userId}/fact_check_history/{hist.description: Tracked fact-check search topics providing auto-complete suggestions and quick re-verification of recurring topics.
